assertions.text: PLAN.md file exists at the output path
Plan contains a '## Goal' section with a one-sentence goal statement
assertions.evidence: ## Goal: 'Add a background job that queries the users table daily for subscriptions expiring in exactly 7 days and sends each affected user a notification email.'

assertions.text: Plan contains a '## Files' section listing specific file paths (not just vague module names)
assertions.evidence: ## Files section lists 11 entries with full paths like src/modules/users/User.ts, src/jobs/subscriptionExpiryJob.ts, src/jobs/scheduler.ts, etc.

assertions.text: Plan contains at least 3 numbered implementation steps
At least one step references a specific file name or function name
assertions.evidence: Step 1: 'Add subscriptionExpiresAt: Date | null to src/modules/users/User.ts'; Step 3: 'Add findUsersExpiringOn(date: Date) to src/modules/users/userRepository.ts'

assertions.text: Plan contains a '## Tests' section describing what to test
assertions.evidence: ## Tests section with 6 distinct test scenarios including file names like userRepository.test.ts and subscriptionExpiryJob.test.ts

assertions.text: Plan contains a '## Edge Cases' section
assertions.evidence: ## Edge Cases section with 7 edge cases: null email, cancelled subscription, duplicate sends, timezone sensitivity, large volumes, SMTP failure, null data
